SELECT VMVT.TMP_CODE tmpCode, VMVT.TMP_NAME tmpName,
DETAIL.SUBJECT_NO subjectNo, DETAIL.SUBJECT_NAME subjectName, DETAIL.CD_FLAG cdFlag, DETAIL.CCY ccy, DETAIL.O_HAPPEN_AMT oHappenAmt, DETAIL.HAPPEN_NUMBER happenNumber,
VMVT.BUSI_TYPE busiType, VMVT.REMARK remark, VMVT.CREATE_USER createUser FROM VAL_MANUAL_VOUCHER_TMP VMVT LEFT JOIN VAL_MANUAL_VOUCHER_TMP_DETAIL DETAIL ON VMVT.TMP_CODE =DETAIL.TMP_CODE WHERE 1=1
AND VMVT.TMP_CODE LIKE '%' || #{tmpCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} || '%'
AND VMVT.TMP_NAME LIKE '%' || #{tmpName,jdbcType=VARCHAR} || '%'
AND VMVT.BUSI_TYPE=#{busiType,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
GROUP BY VMVT.TMP_CODE , VMVT.TMP_NAME ,
DETAIL.SUBJECT_NO , DETAIL.SUBJECT_NAME , DETAIL.CD_FLAG , DETAIL.CCY , DETAIL.O_HAPPEN_AMT , DETAIL.HAPPEN_NUMBER ,
VMVT.BUSI_TYPE , VMVT.REMARK , VMVT.CREATE_USER ORDER BY VMVT.TMP_CODE DESC
